summary.name: Paintit.ai
summary.one_liner: Paintit.ai is an AI interior design tool that redesigns, repaints or stages photos of interiors, exteriors and commercial spaces from an image, preset or text prompt.
keywords: how to redesign a room with ai
use_cases: Redesign a room from a photo before renovating
Mock up commercial space updates for client approval
Test paint colors and furniture swaps
Create marketing visuals for Airbnb or short-term rentals
Find purchasable furniture matching a design
summary.what_it_does: Users upload a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), a floor plan or a rough sketch, or start from a preset or text prompt, then chat with the AI to redesign, repaint or stage the space. Targeted editing lets users keep existing furniture and change only wall color or flooring. The Real Furniture feature identifies items in a design and suggests purchasable matches from retailers, and every item in a generated image can link to a product page. Paid plans add higher-quality and 4K exports, watermark-free results, and Pro/Max features such as 360° views, Image to 3D, Floor Plan, CAD/DXF export, and paint colors from major brands. The page also describes a partner program for placing products into AI-generated scenes.
notable: Real Furniture feature suggests purchasable matches from retailers, available on the free plan
Targeted editing changes wall color or flooring while keeping existing furniture
Floor plan, CAD/DXF export, 360° views and Image to 3D on Pro and Max plans
Private Mode on paid plans keeps uploads out of public galleries
caveats: Free plan starts with 30 credits; advanced features, 4K exports and commercial licence require paid Pro or Max plans
Commercial use for real estate staging requires the Pro plan
Reviewer notes some renders can be slightly off and exports have limited layout notes
